packageRules.description: Bump the pinned vig-os/org-config reusable-workflow tag/SHA in the caller workflows (ADR-0006). Renovate updates the `@vX.Y.Z` / `@<sha>` ref in `uses: vig-os/org-config/.github/workflows/*.yml@...`.

_sha_pinning_note: For SHA pinning (recommended for medtech / exo-pet, ADR-0006): pin `uses: ...@<40-char-sha>` and add a trailing `# vX.Y.Z` comment. Renovate keeps the digest current and updates the comment. To auto-convert tag pins to digests fleet-wide, also add "helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests" to `extends`. Remove this key — it is documentation only.
